jobs.title: Unarmed Patrol & Incident Response Officer
jobs.description:
Allied Universal is seeking a Security Officer Patrol Incident Response in Austin, TX. You will provide customer service to clients, employees, and visitors, and perform security-related procedures across a financial institution and adjacent areas.

Responsibilities include responding to alarms and incidents, conducting routine and random patrols, monitoring access points, and reporting concerns with accurate documentation. This is a full-time, on-site role with a competitive hourly pay.

jobs.title: Daytime Unarmed Patrol Officer — Safe Driving & Response
jobs.description:
ACT Security Group in Austin is seeking a security officer for daytime and evening shifts. Schedule: Thursday 1:00 PM-10:00 PM; Friday-Sunday 7:00 AM-5:00 PM. Compensation starts at $19 per hour with benefits.

Duties include vehicle inspections, on-call response to issues, customer service, and maintaining safe driving standards. We offer tenure compensation up to 80 hours per year, Health & Wellness Plans, Gym Membership, Daily Pay, Direct Deposit, and license/renewal assistance.
